title: A proof of the Szegő conjecture on Jacobi extrema
summary: For Jacobi polynomials with parameters greater than $-1/2$, and with the relative extrema enumerated from the endpoint $x=1$, the normalised modulus at the $k$th extremum of degree $n+1$ is proved to be strictly smaller than that at the $k$th extremum of degree $n$, for $1\leq k\leq n$. This proves the Szegő conjecture, recorded in the 1975 fourth edition of his classic monograph Orthogonal Polynomials, and strengthens it by removing the ordering assumption on the parameters.
